(377)༄༅/ /theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (377)༄༅// theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong gi dkar chag bzhugs so//

༄// mkhas pa chen po gzhon nu rgyal mchog pa dang*/ mus pa chen po dkon mchod rgyal mtshan pa dpon slob gnyis kyis theg pa chen po blo sbyong gi rgya gzhung bod gzhung shin tu gces pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i pusti 'dir bzhugs pa'i dpe tshan gyi rnam grangs la/ jo bo rjes rgyal srid spangs te thar pa sgrub pa'i rnam thar 'brom ston gyis mdzad pa/ jo bo mnyam med gser gling pa dang mjal ba'i rnam thar/ blo sbyong don bdun ma'i gzhung mchan yod pa gcig /med pa gcig /blo sbyong don bdun ma'i 'grel pa/ blo sbyong mtshon cha 'khor lo/ blo sbyong rma bya dug 'joms/ gyer sgom rdo rje'i glu/ byams pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i blo sbyong*/ blo sbyong sems dpa'i rim pa/ sems dpa'i rim pa las rang rgyud ngan pa sma dbab pa/ sems dpa'i rim pa las zag bcas dge ba'i stobs bskyed pa/ gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba'i blo sbyong*/ nyon mongs lam du slong ba'i man ngag /bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ theg chen mkhon spyod/ jo bo la rnal 'byor ma gnyis kyis sems sbyongs shig ces gnang ba'i blo sbyong*/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog /skyid sdug lam khyer/ sum pa lo tsā ba la mkha' 'gro mas gnang ba'i blo sbyong*// kun tu bzang po'i blo sbyong*/ blo sbyong thun brgyad ma/ zas la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ dbugs la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ lus gang gā klung gi bye ma snyed du sprul nas rigs drug gi sdug bsngal dang du len pa'i blo sbyong*/ sha khrag la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ gtor ma la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ 'byung ba la brten pa'i blo sbyong*/ lus yid bzhin nor bur bsgyur ba'i blo sbyong*/ 'chi kha ma'i blo sbyong*/ gegs sel (378)blo sbyong*/ ma 'ongs pa'i 'gal rkyen spong ba'i blo sbyong*/ jo bo'i blo sbyong don bdun ma/

mchims kyi blo sbyong*/ bir wa pa'i blo sbyong*/ rnam dag gtsug gi nor bu la gnang ba'i blo sbyong*/ blo sbyong tshig rkang brgyad ma lo rgyus dang bcas pa/ glang thang pa'i tshig rkang brgyad ma'i 'grel pa/ a ti sha la gser gling pas mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i ched du gnang ba'i blo sbyong*/ theg pa chen po'i blo sbyong zhes pa'i dpe tshan gcig /zhang ratna gu ru'i tshogs chos chen mo// yang dgon pa'i blo sbyong*/ rten 'brel snying po'i khrid yig rnams bzhugs so/// sarba maṅga laṃ/
